tools.name: company_context
tools.title: Company Context
tools.description: Read Company Context knowledge pills - the question/answer notes extracted from files in the Context Center. Pass 'query' to find pills that answer a question, or 'fqn' to read one you already have the name of; exactly one of the two. Either way the scope is the same: file-extracted pills shared with the organization. Each result carries the pill's title, question, answer, summary and source file, so a search result is usually enough on its own and needs no follow-up read. 'query' needs vector embeddings configured on the server; 'fqn' does not.

query.description: Natural-language question to match pills against, e.g. 'how do we define an active customer'. Mutually exclusive with 'fqn'.

fqn.description: Fully qualified name of a single pill, exactly as a previous result returned it. Mutually exclusive with 'query'.

size.description: Number of pills to return for a 'query'. Default 10, maximum 50.

from.description: Offset of the first result. Prefer 'cursor' for paging.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination token. Pass the 'nextCursor' from a previous response to fetch the next page.

tools.name: search_metadata
tools.title: Search Metadata
tools.description: Search retained governance and Context Center entities by keyword or a precise queryFilter. The server adds a mandatory entity-type filter for this distribution. For several known FQNs, use a terms filter on fullyQualifiedName with lowercase values, then get_entity_details for exact reads. Results follow the authenticated caller permissions.

parameters.description: Parameters for the governance-context distribution. See supported entity types and tool description.

query.description: Natural language search query. Use this for simple searches. Examples: 'tables owned by marketing', 'dashboards with customer data', 'tier1 tables', 'tables with column SKU', 'BigQuery services'. The query will be automatically converted to an optimized search.

entityType.description: Supported types: glossary, glossaryTerm, classification, tag, page, contextMemory, contextFile, contextFileContent, folder, file, directory, spreadsheet, worksheet, driveService, user, team, role, policy, persona, type, domain, workflowDefinition. all and dataAsset are aggregate search scopes; the server still restricts results to retained types.

queryFilter.description: Elasticsearch/OpenSearch query DSL, as a JSON object or JSON string, optionally wrapped in query. The server ANDs it with the distribution filter. Example: {"term":{"entityType":"glossaryTerm"}}. Exact fullyQualifiedName term values must be lowercase.

from.description: Offset from the first result. Default is 0. Prefer using 'cursor' for pagination.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination token. Pass the 'nextCursor' value from a previous response to fetch the next page. Omit for the first page.

size.description: Number of results to return. Default is 10. For broad or generic queries (e.g. 'show all tables'), keep size small (5-10), as results are summaries; use get_entity_details for full entity info. Only increase size when the query is specific enough that results will be narrow and focused. Maximum allowed is 50.

includeDeleted.description: Include deleted entities in search results. Default is false.

fields.description: Comma-separated additional original entity fields, such as owners,tags,description.

includeAggregations.description: Whether to include aggregation data (facets) in the response. Defaults to false to optimize LLM context size. Set to true only when you need aggregation statistics like counts by service type, owner, tags, etc. Aggregations can significantly increase response size.

maxAggregationBuckets.description: Maximum number of aggregation buckets to return per field when includeAggregations is true. Limits response size to prevent context overflow. Default is 10, maximum allowed is 50.

excludeEntityTypes.description: Entity types to drop from the results, e.g. ['tableColumn']. Column documents sit inside the default 'dataAsset' scope, so a broad sweep can return mostly columns inheriting their parent's tags or certification. Excluded hits are removed and counted under 'excludedByType'.

tools.name: semantic_search
tools.title: Semantic Search
tools.description: Meaning-based discovery within retained governance and Context Center entities. Requires configured vector embeddings and a compatible search backend. When embeddings are disabled, use search_metadata. Entity filters are nested under filters; the server restricts them to supported types.

parameters.description: Parameters for the governance-context distribution. See supported entity types and tool description.

query.description: Natural language query describing what you're looking for. Semantic search finds conceptually similar results, so phrasing matters more than exact keywords. Examples: 'customer purchase history', 'tables tracking revenue metrics', 'pipeline processing user events'.

filters.description: Optional filters on retained entity types and original indexed fields, e.g. {"entityType":["glossaryTerm","page"],"tags":["PII.Sensitive"]}. Removed entity types are rejected.

size.description: Number of parent entities to return. Default is 10, maximum is 50.

k.description: Number of nearest neighbors to consider internally (KNN parameter). Higher values may improve result quality at the cost of latency. Default is 100.

threshold.description: Minimum similarity score threshold (0.0 to 1.0). Results below this score are excluded. Default is 0.0 (no filtering). Use higher values like 0.5 or 0.7 to get only highly relevant results.

from.description: Zero-based offset of the first parent entity to return. Prefer 'cursor' for paging; use 'from' only when you need to jump to a specific offset.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination token. Pass the 'nextCursor' value from a previous response to fetch the next page. Omit for the first page.

tools.name: get_entity_details
tools.title: Get Entity Details
tools.description: Read original details of supported governance and Context Center entities, with caller authorization. Use entityType + fqn, or up to 10 entityType:fqn strings in entities. Optional context and content sections remain available. Lineage and quality sections are unavailable in this distribution.

parameters.description: Use 'fullyQualifiedName' and 'entityType' from search results directly.

entityType.description: Supported types in this distribution: glossary, glossaryTerm, classification, tag, page, contextMemory, contextFile, contextFileContent, folder, file, directory, spreadsheet, worksheet, driveService, user, team, role, policy, persona, type, domain, workflowDefinition.

fqn.description: Fully qualified name of the entity. Use the exact 'fullyQualifiedName' from a search result when you have one, or a known-good FQN the user supplied. Do not assemble an FQN from parts you are guessing at.

include.description: Optional context and content sections. context attaches glossary/article knowledge; content reads a knowledge item body. Both retain original permissions. lineage and quality are unavailable.

entities.description: Up to 10 supported entityType:fqn strings, for example glossaryTerm:Finance.Revenue or page:Handbook. A mixed batch containing a removed type is rejected before repository access.

query.description: Focuses the 'context' and 'content' sections on one question: context ranks the attached knowledge by relevance to it, and content returns matching passages instead of the whole body. Ignored by the other sections.

format.description: Rendering for the 'context' and 'content' sections: markdown (default) or json.

passages.description: How many passages the 'content' section returns when 'query' is given (1-10).

tools.name: get_persona_context
tools.title: Get Persona Context
tools.description: Get the shared AI context document curated for a persona. With no personaName, uses the caller's active persona. The document can contain many assets and is returned in deterministic parts; call again with part=2, part=3, and so on while hasMore is true. Access is limited to persona members, admins, and bots.

personaName.description: Optional persona fully qualified name. Omit to use the caller's active persona. The persona name comes from get_user_context, which returns the caller's active persona under 'persona.name' — that is the only place to obtain it; do not construct it.

format.description: Output format to page: markdown (default) or json.

part.description: One-based document part to return. Start at 1 and continue while hasMore is true.

tools.name: get_user_context
tools.title: Get User Context
tools.description: Get context about the CURRENT authenticated user: identity (id, name, displayName, email, isAdmin, isBot), team memberships, roles (direct and team-inherited), domains, active persona, and lightweight summaries of owned and followed entities. Use this to answer identity questions such as 'what is my role?', 'which teams am I on?', 'what do I own?', or 'what do I follow?' before asking the user for their email. The user is resolved from the authenticated request; there is no user parameter and the tool cannot read another user's context.

includeOwnedSummary.description: Include a summary of entities owned by the user and their teams. Defaults to true.

includeFollowedSummary.description: Include a summary of entities the user follows. Defaults to true.

ownedLimit.description: Max owned entities to return in the recent list (1-100). Defaults to 20.

followedLimit.description: Max followed entities to return (1-100). Defaults to 20.

ownedFilter.description: Narrow owned entities to ones worth surfacing: NONE (default, all owned), MISSING_DESCRIPTION (description not complete), MISSING_TIER (no tier assigned), ANY_GAP (missing description or tier). Gap filters apply to data-asset entity types only. Results are sorted by updatedAt descending.

tools.name: find_context
tools.title: Find Context
tools.description: Find business context in glossary definitions and Context Center articles for a question. Requires configured vector embeddings; the no-model baseline does not provide semantic retrieval.

parameters.description: Parameters for the governance-context distribution. See supported entity types and tool description.

query.description: Natural-language question or business terms to find relevant company knowledge and candidate assets for.

size.description: Number of knowledge items to return. Default is 10, maximum is 50.

format.description: Output format. 'markdown' (default) returns definitions and candidate assets as an LLM-friendly document. 'json' returns the structured result.

tools.name: create_entity
tools.title: Create Entity
tools.description: Create a retained entity through its original repository, with original validation, authorization and versioning. Does not modify existing entities; use patch_entity for edits. Read describe_entity_type first for required attributes. Allowed types: glossary, glossaryTerm, classification, tag, page, contextMemory, contextFile, folder.

entityType.description: Supported types in this distribution: glossary, glossaryTerm, classification, tag, page, contextMemory, contextFile, folder.

name.description: Entity name, unique within its parent scope.

description.description: Description of the entity in markdown.

owners.description: User or team names to own the entity, e.g. ['john.doe', 'Data Platform']. A name that resolves to neither fails the call.

domains.description: Domain FQNs the entity belongs to.

reviewers.description: User or team names to review the entity.

attributes.description: Fields specific to this entityType. Values match the entity schema returned by describe_entity_type. EntityReference fields use objects such as {'type': 'glossary', 'fullyQualifiedName': 'Finance'} or {'type': 'glossary', 'id': '<uuid>'}; arrays of references use arrays of those objects.

tools.name: describe_entity_type
tools.title: Describe Entity Type
tools.description: Return the 'attributes' create_entity accepts for one entityType: each field's name, type, whether it is required, and its allowed values. Call this before create_entity when the type's requirements are not already known, rather than guessing attribute names.

entityType.description: Supported types in this distribution: glossary, glossaryTerm, classification, tag, page, contextMemory, contextFile, contextFileContent, folder, file, directory, spreadsheet, worksheet, driveService, user, team, role, policy, persona, type, domain, workflowDefinition.

tools.name: patch_entity
tools.title: Patch Entity
tools.description: Update an existing entity using an RFC 6902 JSON Patch document. This tool never creates entities; use create_entity for creation (specialized entity types require their dedicated APIs). Call get_entity_details on the target first and use field names present in that response. Array fields use plural paths such as /domains, /owners, /tags and /reviewers. Reference values must contain the referenced entity id and type. Writes take effect immediately and can overwrite existing state - confirm the target with the user before calling.

entityType.description: Supported types in this distribution: glossary, glossaryTerm, classification, tag, page, contextMemory, contextFile, folder.

fqn.description: Fully Qualified Name of the Entity to be patched.

patch.description: RFC 6902 operations as a JSON array string. Each operation has 'op', a JSON Pointer 'path' starting with '/', and 'value' when required. Use 'replace' for a field that exists, 'add' for an absent field or array entry, and 'remove' to clear one. Example: [{"op":"replace","path":"/description","value":"new description"}].
